Summer Camp Guide: Outdoors and Adventure Camps

Metro Creative ServicesMetro CreativeOutdoor and Adventure Summer camps across Asheville and Western North Carolina, with locations, dates, and registration and details.

Outdoors and adventure camps are a great fit for kids who would rather be outside than on a screen, whether that means hiking, climbing, paddling, sailing, biking, or learning wilderness skills. Below is a roundup of Outdoors & Adventure summer camps in Asheville and across Western North Carolina, including each camp’s location, session dates, and a link to details or registration. Camps often update schedules as summer gets closer, so this list is refreshed as new sessions and information are announced.

Back to the full 2026 Summer Camp Guide

Outdoor & Adventure Camps Sponsor: Green River Preserve

Green River Preserve is a nonprofit coed summer camp on a 3,400-acre private wildlife preserve in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Western North Carolina, where kids build a joyful connection to nature and learn to be environmental stewards. The camp offers 1-, 2-, and 3-week sessions for rising 1st through 9th graders.

Explore the Preserve
